meta.title: Shiliu Review Desk
meta.description: Shiliu review desk: impeccable's 24 design commands and 62 deterministic detectors in the sidebar. One field at the top to search or paste a path, one click to run all 62 checks, findings grouped by problem — with a hand-drawn paper panel (warm paper or kraft), a full English/Chinese switch and its own light, dark or auto theme.
